title: Take-Two Releases New Official Statement on GTA 6 Online and PC
description: Take-Two has officially addressed the upcoming release of GTA 6, its anticipated Online mode, and the PC version in a brand new statement.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Take-Two Issues New Official Statement Regarding GTA 6 Online and PC Version

Take-Two has officially addressed the upcoming release of *Grand Theft Auto VI* (GTA 6), touching upon its all-but-confirmed Online mode and the much-discussed PC version. As one of the most anticipated titles in gaming history, any official word from the publisher immediately captures the attention of the global gaming community.

### Key Highlights from the Official Statement

According to reports from gaming media outlet GameRant, Take-Two's latest official statement has brought clarity to several major topics that fans and industry analysts have been debating for months:

*   **Release Information**: The publisher officially addressed the rollout of the highly anticipated title.
*   **Online Mode Confirmation**: The all-but-confirmed GTA 6 Online mode received an official mention, highlighting its pivotal role in the franchise's future.
*   **PC Platform Status**: The company also addressed the status of the PC version, a hot-button topic for computer gamers worldwide.

### Industry Context and Player Expectations

Looking back at Rockstar Games' historical launch patterns—such as the staggered releases of *GTA V* and *Red Dead Redemption 2*—console platforms typically take priority before a PC port is introduced. Industry analysis suggests that issuing official statements regarding these platforms helps manage community expectations and maintains strategic control over the game's marketing timeline.

Furthermore, the inclusion of the Online mode in official discussions underscores its expected magnitude. Building upon the unprecedented success of GTA Online, the next-generation iteration is widely projected to serve as a cornerstone for Take-Two's long-term digital revenue.

### Editor's Take

While this official statement may not contain a wealth of new gameplay footage, Take-Two addressing the GTA 6 Online mode and PC version directly is a welcome move. It keeps the community informed and manages anticipation effectively as we inch closer to the game's eventual launch. We will continue to monitor all future updates closely.
